rules.R1: silent_failure_triple_defined=no→downgrade(把崩溃/任一失败当静默失败,定义偷换)
rules.R2: oracle_self_audited=no→downgrade(判据不自审/只报单向,grader risk当零)
rules.R3: claim_contract_ablated=no→downgrade(改进归因于反馈而非claim contract,因果混淆)
rules.R4: calibration_and_unsupported_reported=no→flag(校准不披露或未支持预测隐瞒,过度宣称)
rules.R5: 任一partial→flag(披露覆盖不全,待核)
rules.R6: 全yes→ok(只判声明自洽,不承诺有效)
